verdict.rationale: Opting out of analytics or usage tracking is a fair question for a public web service and developer platform like USCIS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, cookies, or any opt-out control. The items cover case status, FOIA APIs, online filing, fees, and bot-blocking probes, none of which concern tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
